Our Hiring Process!
 
We know that looking for a new role can be both exciting and time-consuming, and we truly appreciate your effort. Here’s a peek into our hiring process for this position, so you know exactly what to expect:
 
 👋 Stage 1: 30-minutes Recruiter Interview
We'll dive into your professional background and experience, share more about SpryPoint and the role, and answer any burning questions you might have.
 
 🧑‍💻 Stage 2: Take Home Assignment
You'll have 2-3 days to complete the assignment, which focuses mainly on Python and Pandas. We’re not expecting perfection, what matters most is how you approach problem-solving!
 
 👥 Stage 3: 1-hour Final Technical Interview
This is a great chance to dive into your career goals, technical experience, and how we can support your growth. You’ll walk the team through your assignment, we’re just as interested in your final solution as we are in your thought process. It’s also an opportunity to showcase your skills and see if there’s a strong team fit!
 
🚀 Stage 4: References/Offer
We'll check your references to confirm all the great things we've learned about you. If all goes well, we’ll be thrilled to extend an offer and welcome you to the team!


💫 Expect More From Your Career at SpryPoint
 
🚀 Work your way - Remote-first environment, flexible working hours across North America, and hub offices in Charlottetown & Atlanta
💰 Competitive Total Rewards - Comprehensive compensation package that grows with you
💻 Complete Setup - MacBook + $800 to create your ideal home workspace
🏥 Total Wellness - Health, dental, vision, and life insurance from day one
 🏝️ Recharge Time - Generous PTO and unlimited sick days
 📈 Future Security - RRSP (Canada) and 401k (US) matching programs
 🧠 Continuous Growth - $2,500 annual development fund, tuition assistance, and Book Bounty program
🧳 Team Connection - Annual company events and team offsites that bring us together

To help us verify candidate authenticity and streamline our screening process, we strongly encourage candidates to include a link to their LinkedIn profile and verify it with their current work email address. While not required, this helps us confirm your professional background and accelerates our review process. Candidates with verified LinkedIn profiles typically receive faster responses and priority consideration during our screening process. Note that all final candidates will complete a background check and identity verification as a part of our SOC 2 compliance procedures.

The Company 
2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 Canada Recipient & Fast 500 North America Recipient 🏆 
 
SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
 
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.
 
Utilities face urgent demand to replace inefficient legacy systems while managing increasing operational complexity, and evolving customer expectations. With more than a decade of experience, and a track record of successful implementations spanning water, electric, and gas utilities, SpryPoint has built a reputation as a trusted and mission-critical partner to utilities across North America.
 
We deliver comprehensive solutions including SpryCIS, SpryEngage, SpryMobile, and SpryWallet that modernize the entire meter-to-cash process. What sets us apart? Our "updates, not upgrades" approach, user-centric design, and unwavering focus on customer success.
 
Backed by strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners since 2023, and an exciting new investment partnership from Insight Partners announced in 2026, we're accelerating our growth while staying true to our core values: lead with kindness, vision with impact, radical honesty, bold disruption, keep it simple, and execute with excellence.
 
Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas. 
 
 
 


Position Overview
 
As a Data Conversion Engineer at SpryPoint you will play a key role in supporting the transformation and migration of utility billing data from legacy systems into our modern utility and billing platform.
 
You will work in the Technical Services department alongside the rest of the Data Conversion team to extract, transform, and load (ETL) customer data, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and quality. You will have opportunities to collaborate with pair programming, learn best practices in data migration, and contribute to process improvements.
 
This role is a great opportunity for someone early in their data engineering career who wants to build strong foundations in data transformation, conversion auditing, and process optimization within a collaborative and iterative environment.

Position Overview
 
As a Data Conversion Engineer at SpryPoint you will play a key role in supporting the transformation and migration of utility billing data from legacy systems into our modern utility and billing platform.
 
You will work in the Technical Services department alongside the rest of the Data Conversion team to extract, transform, and load (ETL) customer data, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and quality. You will have opportunities to collaborate with pair programming, learn best practices in data migration, and contribute to process improvements.
 
This role is a great opportunity for someone early in their data engineering career who wants to build strong foundations in data transformation, conversion auditing, and process optimization within a collaborative and iterative environment.

lists.content:
• Lead and manage ETL migration processes across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring robust data pipeline development and timely project delivery.
  • Develop and maintain efficient extraction, transformation, and loading scripts, utilizing Python, SQL, and related data engineering tools to ensure high-quality data migrations.
  • Implement feedback-driven improvements from clients and internal teams, enhancing data conversion quality, performance, and reliability.
  • Actively contribute to data quality assurance processes and review datasets for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis and profiling of diverse source database schemas (including relational and non-relational legacy systems) to accurately map and facilitate successful data extraction and migration.
  • Collaborate closely with the broader Client Experience team to seamlessly integrate client data into SpryPoint products, enabling smooth and timely go-live processes.
  • Work with the Data Conversion team to establish and promote best practices, create documentation, and drive continuous improvement in data migration processes, automation, and observability.
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly review sessions, clearly communicating progress, raising blockers, and incorporating feedback to continuously improve data engineering tasks and processes.

• Development experience with Python and the pandas module.
  • Development experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience in data migration, ETL processes, process scripting, and automation.
  • Understanding of system design and analysis.
  • A creative approach to problem-solving and learning, and an enjoyment of solving puzzles.

Position Overview
 
SpryPoint builds fantastic web and mobile applications using cutting-edge technologies. As a Product Owner at SpryPoint, you will play a key role in working with our customers and product teams in managing product backlog to execute the product roadmap for: SpryCIS (Customer Information System), SpryBackflow or SpryMobile. lists.content:
• Facilitating discovery sessions with both internal and external stakeholders to refine existing product features and uncover new features
  • Managing and evaluating product ideas from multiple sources both internal and external
  • Facilitating feedback loops throughout the development cycle to ensure ideas translate to valuable products
  • Working closely with a Development Team Lead to ensure the successful delivery of product
  • Engaging with Service Delivery on specific project requirements and influencing customer transition timelines
  • Supporting the Development team through the SCRUM sprint cycles
  • Liaise with Customer Success to identify patterns and trends in customer issues and enhancement requests
  • Providing demonstrations of your products to internal and external stakeholders
  • New feature education to support user enablement - both internal to the company and external to our customers
  • Collaborate on the definition of product management processes and best practices, internal education around processes and best practices
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager on the definition of objectives and key results for our product lines
  • Collaborating with the product management team on Quality Management practices through the design, develop and release cycles
  • Providing forecasts on when items will be available in the product
  • Supporting the sales process for estimating quotable development work
  • Collaborating with business development with responses to RFPs and Statement of Work documents

• You are thorough and detail-oriented
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with frequent context switching, shifting priorities, and the ability to prioritize effectively.
  • You have a tendency to be positive, creative and curious
  • Understanding of system design & analysis
  • Strong B2B product and business experience, including working directly with enterprise customers and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Experience in the Utilities Industry would be an asset
  • You thrive on working closely and collaborating with others whether they be internal to the firm, or directly with our customers

🚀 Interview Process
 
We know your time is valuable, so we've designed a process that's transparent, efficient, and - hopefully - genuinely enjoyable.
 
Here's what to expect:
 
📞 Step 1: Recruiter Screening Conversation
A relaxed conversation to learn more about your background, your goals, and what’s drawing you to SpryPoint.
 
👩‍💼 Step 2: 45-Minute Interview with our Director of PMO
A deeper dive into your delivery approach, project management experience, and leadership style. 
 
📝 Step 3: Project-Based Take-Home Assignment
You'll receive a mid-project scenario for a fictional utility client. Your job is to diagnose what's gone wrong, assess the risks, complete a budget analysis, and build a recovery plan. Think of it as a bit of a scavenger hunt - we'll give you the pieces, and you get to figure out what happened. You'll then present your findings to the panel during the final interview.
 
🎤 Step 4: Final Interview & Presentation
You'll walk senior leadership through your approach and have a chance to talk through your thinking in a collaborative conversation. Depending on availability, the Chief of Staff and a Portfolio Director will be part of the final presentation.
 
🚀 Step 5: References & Offer
We'll check your references to confirm the great things we've learned about you. If all goes well, we'll be thrilled to extend an offer and hopefully welcome you to the team!
 
Throughout the process, we're looking for clear communication, structured thinking, financial ownership, stakeholder management, and a genuine delivery mindset. Most importantly, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to every step. ✨

🚀 Interview Process
 
We know your time is valuable, so we've designed a process that's transparent, efficient, and - hopefully - genuinely enjoyable.
 
Here's what to expect:
 
📞 Step 1: Recruiter Screening Conversation
A relaxed conversation to learn more about your background, your goals, and what’s drawing you to SpryPoint.
 
👩‍💼 Step 2: 45-Minute Interview with our Director of PMO
A deeper dive into your delivery approach, project management experience, and leadership style. 
 
📝 Step 3: Project-Based Take-Home Assignment
You'll receive a mid-project scenario for a fictional utility client. Your job is to diagnose what's gone wrong, assess the risks, complete a budget analysis, and build a recovery plan. Think of it as a bit of a scavenger hunt - we'll give you the pieces, and you get to figure out what happened. You'll then present your findings to the panel during the final interview.
 
🎤 Step 4: Final Interview & Presentation
You'll walk senior leadership through your approach and have a chance to talk through your thinking in a collaborative conversation. Depending on availability, the Chief of Staff and a Portfolio Director will be part of the final presentation.
 
🚀 Step 5: References & Offer
We'll check your references to confirm the great things we've learned about you. If all goes well, we'll be thrilled to extend an offer and hopefully welcome you to the team!

lists.content:
• Leading highly complex, cross-functional enterprise SaaS implementations (or a portfolio of them) using SpryPoint’s hybrid delivery methodology
  • Acting as a trusted, strategic advisor to client executives, understanding their business goals and navigating complex stakeholder dynamics
  • Owning project financials end to end, including budgets, revenue forecasting, effort estimation, and variance reporting to leadership
  • Negotiating scope, budget changes, and high-stakes trade-offs with clients, and evaluating impact against schedules, contingencies, and acceptance criteria
  • Anticipating risks early, building solid contingency plans, and managing strategic dependencies before they become problems
  • Using influence without authority to keep client and internal leaders aligned to milestones and governance
  • Presenting to client steering committees and executive leadership, and owning the story of the project
  • Helping shape our PMO standards, templates, and best practices, and supporting the growth of PM I and PM II teammates

• 7+ years of enterprise project management experience, including leading complex, high-risk implementations
  • Utilities industry experience (electric, water, wastewater, gas, sanitation) is strongly preferred. We’re flexible on the number of years and the industry itself if you’ve led complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise software implementations with a similar scope (think CIS, billing, ERP, asset management, or field service)
  • Strong financial acumen, with a track record of owning budgets, forecasting effort and revenue, and explaining variances with confidence
  • Experience across waterfall and agile methodologies; hybrid delivery experience is a big plus
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence at every level, from project teams to the C-suite
  • Strong critical thinking: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, can pull together conflicting inputs, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
  • A highly organized, detail-oriented approach with strong written and documentation skills
  • Post-secondary degree or diploma, preferably in project management or business administration

• Hands-on experience with management information systems such as CIS, WAMS, MWM, or GIS
  • Experience helping define or improve PMO processes, frameworks, or delivery standards
  • A history of mentoring or coaching other project managers
  • Experience with web-based portfolio or project management tools

We are looking for a Senior SDET to help build our test automation from the ground up. You will design the framework, write the automated tests that give us confidence to ship, and bring modern AI-assisted tooling into how we work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who codes like a developer but is driven by quality.

We are looking for a Senior SDET to help build our test automation from the ground up. You will design the framework, write the automated tests that give us confidence to ship, and bring modern AI-assisted tooling into how we work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who codes like a developer but is driven by quality.

You will be one of the first engineers on a new team, so the patterns you set will shape how the whole organization tests. You will work closely with the QA Engineering Manager and with developers across product squads.

In your first 90 days, the automation framework will be in place, with a proof-of-concept suite running in CI on our highest-risk flows. By six months, you'll have meaningful automated coverage of critical user journeys, a low flaky-test rate, and faster feedback on every change. Ongoing, you'll maintain a trusted, maintainable suite: applying AI tooling where it genuinely saves time, with other engineers picking up the patterns you set.

lists.content:
• Design and build the test automation framework and the standards other engineers will follow.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack: API, integration, and end-to-end UI.
  • Prioritize automation by risk and value, favoring fast, reliable API-level tests over brittle UI tests where possible.
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD so they run automatically on every change and give fast feedback.
  • Drive down flakiness and keep the suite trustworthy, so failures mean something.
  • Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing tools (test generation, self-healing tests, failure triage), and use AI and prompt engineering to accelerate test creation and edge-case discovery.
  • Review AI-generated tests and code with a critical eye (you are the human-in-the-loop, not a rubber stamp).
  • Mentor other engineers on automation practices and help raise testing quality across squads

• 5+ years in software test automation or software engineering with a strong testing focus.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with a modern automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) including building or owning a framework, not just writing tests inside one.
  • Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) and comfort with SQL and database validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS) and containers (Docker).
  • A pragmatic, risk-based mindset and the judgement to know what's worth automating.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or AI test-generation tools in real work (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar), with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts to generate test ideas, edge cases, and to analyze failures.

• Familiarity with Claude and Claude Code.
  • Experience setting up test automation from scratch on a team that had little automation before.
  • Performance testing (k6 / JMeter) or security testing exposure.
  • Experience in a regulated or high-reliability domain (utilities, fintech, healthcare, or similar.
